idle_motion_notes: The man's visible body is just the felt suit-block from the shoulders down with no arms in frame; between periodic-3, periodic-4, periodic-7, periodic-8, periodic-9 and the closing scene-4/scene-6 frames his torso block position is effectively identical, so there is no discernible idle sway, weight-shift, or breathing motion -- he presents as a static 'talking bust.' frame_rate_feel: Source is 30fps per metadata.json, and the sampled key poses look clean and smoothly rendered (no stutter or ghosting between adjacent periodic frames), but the big expression changes (droopy eyes to bulging eyes, mouth shape swaps) appear to land on individual caption words rather than blending continuously through a sentence, giving a 'held pose per beat' comedic timing feel layered on top of otherwise smooth 30fps-capable CG motion -- more akin to a smoothly rendered 2-pose-per-line gag rhythm than either true stop-motion choppiness or fully continuous naturalistic animation.
overall_animation_style_notes: The visual formula is a deadpan, felt-puppet-styled CG bust shot in a locked-off kitchen composition, with all comedic energy concentrated in extreme eye/brow contrast (sleepy-unimpressed vs. shocked-wide) and static, held hand gestures, while heads and bodies stay almost motionless -- a restrained, low-movement-budget style that puts the entire performance on eyes and timed text captions rather than full-body or head animation.
